public.title: Smallest Range Covering Elements from K Lists
public.description: Return [low,high], the smallest inclusive integer range containing at least one value from every sorted nonempty input list. Minimize high-low, then low on ties. There are 1 to 100 lists and at most 1000 total values between -1000000 and 1000000. Duplicates are allowed.
hints: Sort all tagged values and find a window covering all list identifiers.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A sliding window tracks how many lists are represented; shrink while coverage holds and compare range width and low endpoint. O(total values times log total values) time.
